```{r}
df_modeling <- annot_master %>%
  mutate(across(c(starts_with("K_"), site), as.factor)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED50), !is.na(site))

k_cols <- paste0("K_", 3:15)
```

```{r}
#icra
icra<- df_modeling%>%
  filter(species == "icra")

#removing the odd samples.

 ikm <- list()
 
 for (i in 2:15) {
  k_var <- paste0("K_", i)

  if (!k_var %in% names(icra)) next

  # Drop empty factor levels for the K variable
  active_levels <- table(droplevels(as.factor(icra[[k_var]])))

  # Skip if K only has 1 group represented in this subset
 # if (length(active_levels) < 2) {
 #   warning(paste("Skipping", k_var, "because it only contains 1 active factor level in the data."))
  #  next
  #}

  #
  form_base <- as.formula(paste("ED50 ~", k_var, "+ (1 | site)"))
  ikm[[paste0("ik", i, "m")]] <- lmer(form_base, data = icra, REML = TRUE)
}

#
 all_models <- c(
   list("ispp_m" = ikm), 
   ikm
 )

# 2. Extract metrics safely
master_model_table <- imap_dfr(all_models, function(model_obj, model_name) {
  
  # Safeguard: Skip elements that aren't actually fitted model objects
  if (is.list(model_obj) && !inherits(model_obj, "merMod")) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", model_name, "because it is a raw list, not a fitted model."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Safely extract performance metrics
  perf    <- tryCatch(model_performance(model_obj), error = function(e) NULL)
  r2_vals <- tryCatch(r2(model_obj), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  # Fallback to NA if extraction fails for a specific model
  aic_val <- if (!is.null(perf$AIC)) round(perf$AIC, 1) else NA
  bic_val <- if (!is.null(perf$BIC)) round(perf$BIC, 1) else NA
  r2_m    <- if (!is.null(r2_vals$R2_marginal)) round(r2_vals$R2_marginal, 3) else NA
  r2_c    <- if (!is.null(r2_vals$R2_conditional)) round(r2_vals$R2_conditional, 3) else NA
  
  data.frame(
    Model_Name      = model_name,
    AIC             = aic_val,
    BIC             = bic_val,
    Marginal_R2     = r2_m,
    Conditional_R2  = r2_c,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

# 3. View sorted results
master_model_table <- master_model_table %>% arrange(AIC)
print(master_model_table)
```

```{r}
#plot tom's "efficiency frontier"
library(ggrepel) # For non-overlapping labels

# 1. Prepare data (using Conditional_R2 as the primary metric)
# Change 'Conditional_R2' to 'Marginal_R2' if preferred
plot_data <- master_model_table %>%
  rename(R2_target = Conditional_R2)

# 2. Compute the Efficiency (Pareto) Frontier
# Sort by BIC ascending, then calculate cumulative max R2
frontier_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(BIC, desc(R2_target)) %>%
  mutate(cum_max_R2 = cummax(R2_target)) %>%
  filter(R2_target == cum_max_R2) %>%
  distinct(R2_target, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 3. Tag models in main table as Efficient vs. Suboptimal
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(is_frontier = Model_Name %in% frontier_data$Model_Name)

# 4. Generate Efficiency Frontier Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = BIC, y = R2_target)) +
  # Draw step line for efficiency frontier
  # geom_step(
  #   data = frontier_data,
  #   aes(x = BIC, y = R2_target),
  #   direction = "hv",
  #   color = "#1f77b4",
  #   linewidth = 1,
  #   linetype = "dashed"
  # ) +
  # Points for suboptimal models
  geom_point(
    data = filter(plot_data, !is_frontier),
    color = "gray60",
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  # Highlight points on the efficiency frontier
  geom_point(
    data = filter(plot_data, is_frontier),
    color = "#1f77b4",
    size = 4
  ) +
  # Model Labels (non-overlapping)
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Model_Name, color = is_frontier),
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = ifelse(plot_data$is_frontier, "bold", "plain"),
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#1f77b4", "FALSE" = "gray30")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "ICRA Model Efficiency Frontier (BIC vs. Conditional R²)",
    #subtitle = "Dashed line marks Pareto-optimal models (higher R² for a given BIC penalty)",
    x = "BIC ",
    y = expression("Conditional " * R^2 * "")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)

# 1. Filter raw dataset: Keep only K_8 clusters with N > 1
icra_filtered <- icra %>%
  group_by(K_14) %>%
  filter(n() > 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(K_14 = as.factor(K_14)) # Ensure K_8 is treated as a factor

# 2. Refit your winning model on filtered data
# (Update this model formula to match your exact ik8m model structure)
m_filtered <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_11 + (1 | site), data = icra_filtered, REML = TRUE)

# 3. Anova and Extract EMMs and calculate unadjusted/LSD letters
anova(m_filtered) 
performance(m_filtered)
emm <- emmeans(m_filtered, ~ K_11)


cld <- cld(emm, adjust = "none", Letters = letters) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    K_11 = as.factor(K_11),
    .group = trimws(.group)
  )

# 4. Generate Discrete EMM Plot with Raw Points Overlay
ggplot() +
  # Layer A: Raw data jittered points (colored by site)
  geom_jitter(
    data = icra_filtered,
    aes(x = K_6, y = ED50, color = as.factor(site)),# shape = site),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  # Layer B: Model EMMs (Black points + 95% CIs)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = cld,
    aes(x = K_6, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    width = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cld,
    aes(x = K_6, y = emmean),
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Layer C: Post-hoc Significance Letters
  geom_text(
    data = cld,
    aes(x = K_6, y = upper.CL + 0.12, label = .group),
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Styling & Axis Labels
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression(paste(italic("I. crateriformis"), " Within-Species Cluster Performance")),
    subtitle = "Clusters with N ≤ 2 removed; black points show EMMs (± 95% CI)",
    x = "Photophysiological Sub-cluster (K = 6)",
    y = expression(ED[50]~"("*degree*C*")"),
    color = "Site"
  )
```

```{r}
#name columns in K_11 and K_14 for future use 
icra_filtered <- icra_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    # Ensure cluster columns are treated as numeric/character consistently
    K_11_num = as.numeric(as.character(K_11)),
    K_14_num = as.numeric(as.character(K_14)),
    
    # 1. Map Spp_Cluster_11 (Low vs Avg)
    Spp_Cluster_11 = case_when(
      K_11_num == 8                   ~ "low_ed50_11",
      K_11_num %in% c(5, 6, 7, 11)    ~ "avg_ed50_11",
      TRUE                            ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # 2. Map Spp_Cluster_14 (Low vs Avg vs High)
    Spp_Cluster_14 = case_when(
      K_14_num %in% c(9, 10)          ~ "low_ed50_14",
      K_14_num %in% c(6, 7, 8, 13)    ~ "avg_ed50_14",
      K_14_num == 5                   ~ "high_ed50_14",
      TRUE                            ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  # Drop temp numeric helper columns if desired
  dplyr::select(-K_11_num, -K_14_num)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(igraph)

target_species <- "ICRA"

# =========================================================================
# STEP 1: Assign Phenotype Groups & Standardize Metrics (Z-score)
# =========================================================================
df_spp <- df_master %>%
  filter(toupper(species) == target_species) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED50), !is.na(K_11))

# Assign phenotype tiers
df_spp_clean <- df_spp %>%
  mutate(
    K_11_num = as.numeric(as.character(K_11)),
    Spp_Cluster_11 = case_when(
      K_11_num == 8                ~ "low_ed50",
      K_11_num %in% c(5, 6, 7, 11) ~ "avg_ed50",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Spp_Cluster_11))

# Extract clean metric names
spp_pp_metrics <- colnames(Alls.cor_clean)

# Filter valid non-zero variance metrics
spp_pp_metrics_valid <- spp_pp_metrics[sapply(df_spp_clean[, spp_pp_metrics], function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)]

# Standardize metrics (Z-score) across the species subset for standardized spans/effect sizes
df_spp_z <- df_spp_clean
df_spp_z[, spp_pp_metrics_valid] <- scale(df_spp_clean[, spp_pp_metrics_valid])

# =========================================================================
# STEP 2: Identify Collinear Correlation Modules (Full Metric Set)
# =========================================================================
# cor_spp <- cor(df_spp_z[, spp_pp_metrics_valid], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
# adj_spp <- abs(cor_spp) > 0.6
# adj_spp[is.na(adj_spp)] <- FALSE
# diag(adj_spp) <- FALSE
# 
# g_spp <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_spp, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
# collinear_modules <- data.frame(
#   Metric = names(components(g_spp)$membership),
#   Module_ID = paste0("Module_", components(g_spp)$membership)
# )

# STEP 2 REFINED: Strict correlation threshold (|r| > 0.85) to separate giant component
cor_spp <- cor(df_spp_z[, spp_pp_metrics_valid], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
adj_spp <- abs(cor_spp) > 0.85  # Raised from 0.6 to 0.85!
adj_spp[is.na(adj_spp)] <- FALSE
diag(adj_spp) <- FALSE

g_spp <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_spp, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
collinear_modules <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(components(g_spp)$membership),
  Module_ID = paste0("Module_", components(g_spp)$membership)
)

# Inspect new module sizes—you will now see distinct, clean functional modules!
cat("--- REFINED MODULE SIZE DISTRIBUTION (|r| > 0.85) ---\n")
print(sort(table(collinear_modules$Module_ID), decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])

# =========================================================================
# STEP 3: Hypothesis Test ALL Metrics + BH Adjustment Across ALL
# =========================================================================
all_metric_results <- purrr::map_dfr(spp_pp_metrics_valid, function(trait) {
  # Perform linear model on Z-scored metric
  fit <- lm(as.formula(paste(trait, "~ Spp_Cluster_11")), data = df_spp_z)
  p_val <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  # Calculate summary stats and Cohen's d (Effect Size)
  low_vals <- df_spp_z[[trait]][df_spp_z$Spp_Cluster_11 == "low_ed50"]
  avg_vals <- df_spp_z[[trait]][df_spp_z$Spp_Cluster_11 == "avg_ed50"]
  
  mean_low <- mean(low_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_avg <- mean(avg_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  diff_mean <- mean_avg - mean_low
  
  # Pooled Standard Deviation for Cohen's d
  sd_pooled <- sqrt(((length(low_vals)-1)*var(low_vals, na.rm=TRUE) + 
                      (length(avg_vals)-1)*var(avg_vals, na.rm=TRUE)) / 
                     (length(low_vals) + length(avg_vals) - 2))
  
  cohens_d <- diff_mean / sd_pooled
  
  data.frame(
    Metric = trait,
    Metric_Family = str_extract(trait, "(mABQ|qABQ|ABQ|Sigma|Connect|Tau1|Tau2|NPQ|qP|Ratio)"),
    Mean_Low_Z = mean_low,
    Mean_Avg_Z = mean_avg,
    Diff_Z = diff_mean,
    Cohens_D = cohens_d,
    P_Value = p_val
  )
}) %>%
  # BH Adjustment across ALL tested metrics
  mutate(
    P_Adj_FDR = p.adjust(P_Value, method = "BH"),
    Significant = P_Adj_FDR < 0.05
  ) %>%
  # Join Module Assignments
  left_join(collinear_modules, by = "Metric")

# =========================================================================
# STEP 4: Rank Significant Metrics by Effect Size (|Cohen's d|)
# =========================================================================
sig_ranked_results <- all_metric_results %>%
  filter(Significant == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Cohens_D)))

cat("\n===================================================================\n")
cat("SUMMARY: Total Metrics Tested:", nrow(all_metric_results), "\n")
cat("Total Significant (FDR < 0.05):", nrow(sig_ranked_results), "\n")
cat("===================================================================\n\n")

cat("--- TOP SIGNIFICANT METRICS RANKED BY EFFECT SIZE (COHEN'S D) ---\n")
print(head(sig_ranked_results %>% 
             dplyr::select(Metric, Module_ID, Mean_Low_Z, Mean_Avg_Z, Cohens_D, P_Value, P_Adj_FDR), 15))

# =========================================================================
# STEP 5: Summarize Results by Physiological Module
# =========================================================================
module_summary <- sig_ranked_results %>%
  group_by(Module_ID, Metric_Family) %>%
  summarise(
    Num_Sig_Metrics = n(),
    Max_Effect_Size = max(abs(Cohens_D)),
    Mean_Effect_Size = mean(Cohens_D),
    Top_Metric = Metric[which.max(abs(Cohens_D))],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Num_Sig_Metrics), desc(Max_Effect_Size))

cat("\n--- CONCENTRATION OF DIFFERENCES BY PHYSIOLOGICAL MODULE ---\n")
print(module_summary)

# STEP 5 REFINED: Family-First Summary Table
family_summary <- sig_ranked_results %>%
  group_by(Metric_Family) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Significant = n(),
    Mean_Cohens_D = mean(Cohens_D),
    Max_Cohens_D  = Cohens_D[which.max(abs(Cohens_D))],
    Top_Representative_Metric = Metric[which.max(abs(Cohens_D))],
    P_Adj_Best = min(P_Adj_FDR),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(N_Significant))

cat("\n--- FUNCTIONAL TRAIT FAMILY SUMMARY (ICRA LOW VS AVG ED50) ---\n")
print(family_summary)
```

```{r}
# Extract Module 4 metric names
mod4_metrics <- collinear_modules %>%
  filter(Module_ID == "Module_4") %>%
  pull(Metric)

# Run PCA on standardized Module 4 matrix
pca_mod4 <- prcomp(df_spp_z[, mod4_metrics], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Add PC scores back to dataframe
df_spp_z$PC1_Mod4 <- pca_mod4$x[, 1]
df_spp_z$PC2_Mod4 <- pca_mod4$x[, 2]

# Test if PC1 significantly separates Low vs Avg ED50
pc1_fit <- lm(PC1_Mod4 ~ Spp_Cluster_11, data = df_spp_z)
pc1_p   <- summary(pc1_fit)$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]

cat("\n--- MODULE 4 PCA RESULTS ---\n")
cat("PC1 Variance Explained:", round(summary(pca_mod4)$importance[2, 1] * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("PC1 Separation p-value (Low vs Avg ED50):", pc1_p, "\n")

# Plot PC1 vs PC2 Separation
ggplot(df_spp_z, aes(x = PC1_Mod4, y = PC2_Mod4, color = Spp_Cluster_11, fill = Spp_Cluster_11)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8, aes(shape = Spp_Cluster_11)) +
  stat_ellipse(geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.15, level = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("low_ed50" = "firebrick3", "avg_ed50" = "navyblue")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("low_ed50" = "firebrick3", "avg_ed50" = "navyblue")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Latent Photophysiological Axis (Module 4 PCA)",
    subtitle = paste0("PC1 explains ", round(summary(pca_mod4)$importance[2, 1] * 100, 1), 
                      "% of variance; separates Low-ED50 phenotype (p = ", format.pval(pc1_p, digits = 3), ")"),
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_mod4)$importance[2, 1] * 100, 1), "% Var)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca_mod4)$importance[2, 2] * 100, 1), "% Var)"),
    color = "Phenotype", fill = "Phenotype", shape = "Phenotype"
  )
```

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. PERMANOVA across all Module 4 metrics (Euclidean distance)
dist_mod4 <- dist(df_spp_z[, mod4_metrics])
permanova_res <- adonis2(dist_mod4 ~ Spp_Cluster_11, data = df_spp_z)

cat("--- PERMANOVA TEST (Module 4 Multi-dimensional Separation) ---\n")
print(permanova_res)

# 2. Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) to find the EXACT axis separating the groups
library(MASS)
lda_fit <- lda(Spp_Cluster_11 ~ ., data = df_spp_z[, c("Spp_Cluster_11", rep_traits)])
lda_pred <- predict(lda_fit)

df_spp_z$LDA1 <- lda_pred$x[, 1]

# Plot the 1D Discriminant Separation
ggplot(df_spp_z, aes(x = LDA1, fill = Spp_Cluster_11)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_rug(aes(color = Spp_Cluster_11), length = unit(0.05, "npc"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("low_ed50" = "firebrick3", "avg_ed50" = "navyblue")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("low_ed50" = "firebrick3", "avg_ed50" = "navyblue")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Discriminant Photophysiological Separation",
    subtitle = "Low-ED50 phenotype forms a distinct, highly cohesive physiological state",
    x = "Linear Discriminant Score (LDA1)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Phenotype", color = "Phenotype"
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
n_permutations <- 1000
null_sig_counts <- numeric(n_permutations)

cat("\nRunning 1,000 Permutations (Shuffling n=6 vs n=53 labels)...\n")

pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_permutations, style = 3)
for (i in 1:n_permutations) {
  # Shuffle labels
  shuffled_labels <- sample(df_spp_z$Spp_Cluster_11)
  
  # Run fast matrix-based t-tests across all valid metrics
  p_vals_null <- apply(df_spp_z[, spp_pp_metrics_valid], 2, function(x) {
    t.test(x ~ shuffled_labels)$p.value
  })
  
  # Apply BH correction
  fdr_null <- p.adjust(p_vals_null, method = "BH")
  null_sig_counts[i] <- sum(fdr_null < 0.05)
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
}
close(pb)

# Calculate empirical p-value for the permutation test
empirical_p <- sum(null_sig_counts >= nrow(sig_ranked_results)) / n_permutations

cat("\n--- PERMUTATION TEST RESULTS ---\n")
cat("Observed Significant Metrics (Real Data):", nrow(sig_ranked_results), "\n")
cat("Max Significant Metrics in 1,000 Random Shuffles:", max(null_sig_counts), "\n")
cat("Empirical p-value:", empirical_p, "\n")
```

```{r}
#K_11
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(igraph)
library(purrr)

target_species <- "ICRA"

# =========================================================================
# STEP 1: Filter to Target Species & Assign Statistical Phenotype Tiers
# =========================================================================
df_spp <- df_master %>%
  filter(toupper(species) == target_species) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED50), !is.na(K_11))

# Assign Spp_Cluster_11 tiers based on EMM Tukey CLD groups
df_spp_clean <- df_spp %>%
  mutate(
    K_11_num = as.numeric(as.character(K_11)),
    Spp_Cluster_11 = case_when(
      K_11_num == 8                ~ "low_ed50_11",
      K_11_num %in% c(5, 6, 7, 11) ~ "avg_ed50_11",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Spp_Cluster_11)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-K_11_num)

# Filter out groups with <= 3 samples
valid_tiers <- df_spp_clean %>%
  count(Spp_Cluster_11) %>%
  filter(n > 3) %>%
  pull(Spp_Cluster_11)

df_spp_clean <- df_spp_clean %>%
  filter(Spp_Cluster_11 %in% valid_tiers)

cat("Processing species:", target_species, "\n")
cat("Retained samples:", nrow(df_spp_clean), "across tiers:", paste(valid_tiers, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# =========================================================================
# STEP 2: Measure Metric Span Across Phenotype Tiers (Low vs Avg)
# =========================================================================
spp_pp_metrics <- colnames(Alls.cor_clean)

metric_spans <- df_spp_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(Spp_Cluster_11, all_of(spp_pp_metrics)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Spp_Cluster_11, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Metric, Spp_Cluster_11) %>%
  summarise(
    Group_Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Group_Median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Span = max(Group_Median) - min(Group_Median),
    Mean_Span   = max(Group_Mean) - min(Group_Mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric_Family = str_extract(Metric, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Median_Span))

top10_spans <- head(metric_spans, 10)
cat("\n--- TOP 10 METRICS BY MEDIAN SPAN ACROSS PHENOTYPE TIERS (ICRA) ---\n")
print(top10_spans %>% dplyr::select(Metric, Metric_Family, Median_Span))

# =========================================================================
# STEP 3: Correlation Matrix & Collinear Metric Modules
# =========================================================================
spp_pp_metrics_valid <- spp_pp_metrics[sapply(df_spp_clean[, spp_pp_metrics], function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)]

cor_spp <- cor(df_spp_clean[, spp_pp_metrics_valid], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

adj_spp <- abs(cor_spp) > 0.6
adj_spp[is.na(adj_spp)] <- FALSE
diag(adj_spp) <- FALSE

g_spp <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_spp, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
clusters_spp <- components(g_spp)$membership

collinear_clusters_df <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(clusters_spp),
  Collinear_Cluster_ID = clusters_spp
) %>%
  filter(Metric %in% metric_spans$Metric) %>%
  mutate(Metric_Family = str_extract(Metric, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+"))

cat("\n--- TOP COLLINEAR TRAIT MODULES WITHIN", target_species, "---\n")
print(head(collinear_clusters_df, 10))

# =========================================================================
# STEP 4: Significance Testing Across Tiers with FDR Correction
# =========================================================================
p_val_results <- purrr::map_dfr(top10_spans$Metric, function(trait) {
  # Model trait against the binary Spp_Cluster_11 tier (low_ed50_11 vs avg_ed50_11)
  form <- as.formula(paste(trait, "~ Spp_Cluster_11"))
  fit <- lm(form, data = df_spp_clean)
  p_val <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  data.frame(
    Metric = trait,
    Metric_Family = str_extract(trait, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+"),
    P_Value = p_val
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    P_Adj_FDR = p.adjust(P_Value, method = "BH"),
    Significant = P_Adj_FDR < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(P_Adj_FDR)

cat("\n--- FDR SIGNIFICANCE TESTING: LOW VS AVG ED50 TIERS (ICRA) ---\n")
print(p_val_results)
```
